---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for Garfield
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

Please search [existing issues](../../issues?q=is%3Aissue) first.

## Expected Behavior

How should it work? A code example or pseudo-config that shows the proposed API helps.

## Current Behavior

What does Garfield do today? Why can't this be achieved with the current version?

## Context

- How has this affected you?
- What are you trying to accomplish?
- What alternatives have you considered (e.g., custom SPI implementation)?
- Are you aware of any workarounds?

## Implementation Idea (optional)

If you have an idea of how this should be implemented (e.g., a new SPI, a config knob),
sketch it here. Garfield favors **SPI-first** and **configuration-driven** designs — see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#design-principles).
